name: Fractera Blocks
summary: The registry of page blocks: every block as source code with its dependencies, served the shadcn way (API) and as commands for an agent (MCP).

port.note: A wish, not a decision. The node assigns the actual port from the block 24680-24699. Ask the node, never remember.

runtime.note: server.js is the service (node:http). `npm run build` = `shadcn build` (registry.json → public/r/*.json) + the site (presentation/, Next 16 Cache Components) into the folder NEXT_DIST_DIR names; `.presentation-dist` marks it. One copy of block code: registry/src/ serves the registry AND the site (tsconfig fallback path).

doors.gives: the public home page of the element — indexable, breadcrumbs and FAQ by the project settings
the machine twin of the home page for agents
search signals; the sitemap lists pages only once the element has a real public address
liveness and the number of blocks in the built registry
the registry index — what `npx shadcn add @fractera/<name>` reads
one block: files with source, npm and registry dependencies
MCP: the same blocks as commands for an agent
the project design this element renders with (key X-Settings-Key)

languages.note: The public home page speaks en and ru.

settings.note: The project design is INHERITED: the core sends the design to every element with this door; the page is rebuilt with it on the next deployment.
